title: Forward deployed engineer is as common as machine learning engineer in AI job ads
description: The forward deployed engineer, who builds AI on site with customers, appears in as many US AI job ads as the machine learning engineer.
dek: Forward deployed engineers build AI on site with the customer. In US AI job ads, the title is as common as machine learning engineer: 304 ads against 306[^1].
findings: Forward deployed engineers build software alongside a customer, on the customer's own data.
In 2,046 recent US AI job ads, 304 carry that title, from 213 employers[^1].
That is level with machine learning engineer, at 306 ads from 210 employers[^1].
Only data scientist (479 ads) and AI engineer (435 ads) are more common[^1].
The title follows Palantir's model of sending engineers to the customer. Palantir pitches a five-day bootcamp: 'From 0 to use case in 5 days'[^2].
Large consulting firms hire for the role too[^1].

chart.title: US AI job ads by job title
chart.subtitle: Ads posted between 21 and 25 Nov 2026; 2,046 ads after reposts removed

method: We pulled the 3,000 newest US job ads with AI or machine-learning job titles, from the JobsPipe job index[^1].
We removed reposts (same title, same company), leaving 2,046 ads.
Each ad goes to the first title group its job title matches, in a fixed order, so no ad is counted twice.
Titles that match none of the groups are left out of the chart.
All 3,000 ads were posted from 21 to 25 Nov 2026, so this is a five-day snapshot, not a trend. We will repeat it monthly.

sources.name: JobsPipe job index
sources.what: The job ads behind our counts: live US postings from 30+ job boards and applicant-tracking systems, deduplicated and with pay parsed into fields.

sources.name: Palantir AIP Bootcamp
sources.what: Palantir's page headline: 'From 0 to use case in 5 days', for a five-day AIP Bootcamp.
